commentaryTypes.matthewHenryDescription: A concise, devotional commentary on the whole Bible from the Puritan tradition. Warm, practical, and easy to read.
commentaryTypes.jamiesonFaussetBrownDescription: A compact, verse-by-verse commentary on the whole Bible. Balanced and accessible.
commentaryTypes.calvinDescription: The Reformer's classic exposition. Deep and doctrinal.

planTypes.mcheyneDescription: A classic plan with four short readings a day. You read through the Old Testament once and the New Testament and Psalms twice in a year.
planTypes.chronologicalDescription: Read the whole Bible in a year, arranged in the order the events actually happened.
planTypes.throughTheBibleDescription: Read straight through the whole Bible in a year, from Genesis to Revelation.
planTypes.gospelsAndEpistlesDescription: Spend the year in the New Testament, journeying through the Gospels and the letters of the apostles.
planTypes.everyDayInTheWordDescription: Four readings a day from the Old Testament, New Testament, Psalms, and Proverbs, covering the whole Bible in a year, with Psalms & Proverbs twice.
planTypes.literaryStudyDescription: Experience the Bible over a year grouped by its literary styles, moving through story, poetry, and letters.
planTypes.chroniclesAndProphetsDescription: A year that pairs the history in Chronicles with the messages of the Prophets.
planTypes.pentateuchAndHistoryDescription: Journey through the five books of Moses and the history of Israel over a year.
planTypes.psalmsAndWisdomDescription: Spend the year in the Psalms and wisdom books like Proverbs, Job, and Ecclesiastes.
planTypes.oldAndNewTestamentDescription: Read through both the Old and New Testaments together, with a passage from each every day.
planTypes.differentTopicsDescription: Rotate through a different section of Scripture each day, exploring every book of the Bible over a year.
planTypes.newTestamentPsalmsProverbsDescription: Read the New Testament alongside Psalms and Proverbs over the course of a year.
planTypes.fiveByFiveByFiveDescription: Read one New Testament chapter a day, five days a week, followed by two days to review and reflect.
planTypes.oldScopeDescription: Reads from books in the Old Testament.
planTypes.newScopeDescription: Reads from books in the New Testament.
planTypes.wholeScopeDescription: Reads from both the Old and New Testaments.
planTypes.focusedDescription: Covers a specific section or collection within its scope.
planTypes.comprehensiveDescription: Covers every book within its scope.

type.name: Type
type.description: The grammatical category of the word.

grammaticalCase.name: Case
grammaticalCase.description: The syntactic role, such as subject, object, or possession.

gender.name: Gender
gender.description: Grammatical gender: masculine, feminine, neuter (Greek), or common (Hebrew).

number.name: Number
number.description: Whether the word refers to one (singular), two (dual), or many (plural).

person.name: Person
person.description: Who the word refers to: 1st (I/we), 2nd (you), or 3rd (he/she/it/they).

state.name: State
state.description: The state of a noun: absolute, construct, or determined.

tense.name: Tense
tense.description: The verb tense, combining time and aspect.

mood.name: Mood
mood.description: How the action is expressed, such as fact, command, or possibility.

voice.name: Voice
voice.description: The voice: active, middle, or passive.

degree.name: Degree
degree.description: The degree of an adjective or adverb: positive, comparative, or superlative.

stem.name: Stem
stem.description: The verb stem (binyan), such as qal, niphal, or piel.

aspect.name: Aspect
aspect.description: The verb aspect, such as perfect, imperfect, or participle.

particle.name: Particle
particle.description: A small uninflected word, often a conjunction or marker.

code.name: Code
code.description: The raw morphology code as it appears in the source text.

conjunction.name: Conjunction
conjunction.description: A word that joins other words or clauses.

preposition.name: Preposition
preposition.description: Relates a noun or pronoun to other words.

adverb.name: Adverb
adverb.description: Modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb.

adjective.name: Adjective
adjective.description: A word that describes a noun.

noun.name: Noun
noun.description: A person, place, thing, or idea.

properNoun.name: Proper noun
properNoun.description: A specific name of a person, place, or thing.

ordinalNumber.name: Ordinal number
ordinalNumber.description: An ordinal number, such as "first" or "second".

pronoun.name: Pronoun
pronoun.description: A word that stands in for a noun.

personalPronoun.name: Personal pronoun
personalPronoun.description: A pronoun that refers to a specific person.

demonstrativePronoun.name: Demonstrative pronoun
demonstrativePronoun.description: A pronoun that points to something.

interrogativePronoun.name: Interrogative pronoun
interrogativePronoun.description: A pronoun used to ask a question.

indefinitePronoun.name: Indefinite pronoun
indefinitePronoun.description: A pronoun referring to non-specific entities.

reflexivePronoun.name: Reflexive pronoun
reflexivePronoun.description: A pronoun referring back to the subject.

relativePronoun.name: Relative pronoun
relativePronoun.description: A pronoun introducing a subordinate clause.

interrogativeParticle.name: Interrogative particle
interrogativeParticle.description: A particle that marks a question.

relativeParticle.name: Relative particle
relativeParticle.description: A particle that introduces a relative clause.

verb.name: Verb
verb.description: A word expressing an action or state.

pronominalSuffix.name: Pronominal suffix
pronominalSuffix.description: A pronoun fused to the end of a verb or noun (Hebrew).

directObjectMarker.name: Direct object marker
directObjectMarker.description: The Hebrew אֵת that marks a definite direct object.

indeclinable.name: Indeclinable
indeclinable.description: A word that does not change form by inflection.

hebraism.name: Hebrew loanword
hebraism.description: A Hebrew or Aramaic loanword carried into Greek.

unknown.name: Unknown
unknown.description: A morphology code that the parser did not recognize.

masculine.name: Masculine
masculine.description: Masculine grammatical gender, used for male persons and many nouns by convention.

feminine.name: Feminine
feminine.description: Feminine grammatical gender, used for female persons and many nouns by convention.

neuter.name: Neuter
neuter.description: Greek neuter gender, neither masculine nor feminine.

common.name: Common
common.description: Hebrew common gender, where the form serves both masculine and feminine.

dual.name: Dual
dual.description: Refers to a natural pair (Hebrew only).

nominative.name: Nominative
nominative.description: Marks the subject of a sentence.

genitive.name: Genitive
genitive.description: Indicates possession or origin, often translated "of".
genitive.examples: the Son of God|kingdom of heaven

dative.name: Dative
dative.description: Marks the indirect object, often "to" or "for".

absolute.name: Absolute
absolute.description: The default, independent form of a noun.

construct.name: Construct
construct.description: Bound to a following noun, expressing "X of Y".
construct.examples: king of Israel|word of the LORD

determined.name: Determined
determined.description: Marked as definite, often by the article.

qal.name: Qal
qal.description: The simple active stem, the basic action of the verb.

qalPassive.name: Qal passive
qalPassive.description: A rare passive of the simple stem.

niphal.name: Niphal
niphal.description: The simple passive or reflexive stem.

piel.name: Piel
piel.description: The intensive or factitive active stem.

hiphil.name: Hiphil
hiphil.examples: he caused to write|he led out

hithpael.name: Hithpael
hithpael.description: The reflexive or reciprocal of the piel.

perfect.name: Perfect
perfect.description: Completed action, typically translated as past.

imperfect.name: Imperfect
imperfect.description: Incomplete or future action, often translated as future or habitual.

infinitiveConstruct.name: Infinitive construct
infinitiveConstruct.description: A verbal noun in construct form, often used with prepositions.

infinitiveAbsolute.name: Infinitive absolute
infinitiveAbsolute.description: An independent verbal noun, often emphatic.

participle.name: Participle
participle.description: A verbal adjective describing ongoing action.

conjunctiveImperfect.name: Conjunctive imperfect
conjunctiveImperfect.description: Imperfect with conjunctive waw, with a future or modal sense.

conjunctivePerfect.name: Conjunctive perfect
conjunctivePerfect.description: Perfect with conjunctive waw, often future or sequential.
conjunctivePerfect.examples: and you shall do|and he will judge

passiveParticiple.name: Passive participle
passiveParticiple.description: The passive form of the qal participle.

jussive.name: Jussive
jussive.examples: Let there be light|May the LORD bless you

cohortative.name: Cohortative
cohortative.description: A 1st-person volitional, such as "let us" or "I will".

hSuffix.name: h-suffix
hSuffix.description: An emphatic -ah ending on the imperfect, often cohortative-like.
hSuffix.examples: I will surely come|let me draw near

imperfect.name: Imperfect
imperfect.examples: he was teaching|they used to gather

aorist.name: Aorist
aorist.description: Simple past action viewed as a whole.

perfect.name: Perfect
perfect.description: Past action with a continuing present consequence.

pluperfect.name: Pluperfect
pluperfect.description: Past action prior to another past event.

subjunctive.name: Subjunctive
subjunctive.examples: that he might write|if he goes

optative.name: Optative
optative.description: Expresses a wish or remote possibility.
optative.examples: may it be so|may you have grace

infinitive.name: Infinitive
infinitive.description: A verbal noun, such as "to do".

participle.name: Participle
participle.description: A verbal adjective, such as "doing" or "having done".

middle.name: Middle
middle.description: The subject acts on or for itself.
middle.examples: he washes himself|they obtained for themselves

middleOrPassive.name: Middle/Passive
middleOrPassive.description: The form is ambiguous between middle and passive.
middleOrPassive.examples: was raised / raised himself|was assembled / assembled themselves

positive.name: Positive
positive.description: The plain form, neither comparative nor superlative.

literals.rawCode: The raw morphology code as it appeared in the source.
literals.bet: The Hebrew bet (בְּ) prefix preposition, meaning "in", "at", or "with".
literals.kaf: The Hebrew kaf (כְּ) prefix preposition, meaning "as" or "like".
literals.lamed: The Hebrew lamed (לְ) prefix preposition, meaning "to", "for", or "belonging to".
literals.mem: The Hebrew mem (מִן) prefix preposition, meaning "from" or "out of".

If there is anything keeping you from leaving a 5-star review, please join our Discord and share your feedback so we can address it quickly.
